query:
SELECT ar.id, ar.name
           FROM artists ar
           WHERE ar.name_key = $1
              OR ar.search @@ (
                  SELECT string_agg(
                             '(' || plainto_tsquery('simple', unaccent(s.v))::text || ')',
                             ' | ')::tsquery
                  FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS s(v)
                  WHERE length(to_tsvector('simple', unaccent(s.v))) > 0)
           ORDER BY (ar.name_key = $1) DESC, ar.id
           LIMIT $3
